name: Ham and Cheese Omelette Wrap
method: Beat the eggs with a pinch of pepper. Heat the oil in a non-stick frying pan over a medium heat.
Pour in the eggs and cook for 2 to 3 minutes, until just set, as a thin omelette. Scatter over the ham and grated cheddar and cook for 1 minute more.
Warm the wrap for 20 seconds, slide the omelette on top, roll up and serve.
